args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212

The function docstring specified banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN),
but the implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN
so round_money matches the FIN-212 requirement and tests/test_money.py.

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but the function's own docstring (and FIN-212) require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This mismatch caused the nightly build to fail on `tests/test_money.py`.

## Change
- Switched the rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `src/money.py`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.

cc @alex for review.
